automated_tests.hardware_mocking: All lock, camera and Office command tests use mocks; real model blank-frame inference and DPAPI roundtrip are separate safe integration checks.

real_hardware_release_verification: Not performed. Do not call this fully verified.

features.feature: Camera consent and setup wizard
features.known_limitations: Windows desktop camera permission must also be enabled

features.feature: Multi-angle face enrollment and quality checks
features.known_limitations: Quality thresholds need camera-specific validation

features.feature: YuNet face detection and SFace CPU embeddings
features.real_windows_testing: Passed (safe model initialization on Windows); real faces not performed
features.known_limitations: No positive-face accuracy benchmark or demographic evaluation

features.feature: Identity matching, uncertainty rejection and consecutive verification
features.known_limitations: Default threshold is a starting point, not a calibrated false-acceptance rate

features.feature: Randomized head-turn liveness
features.automated_tests: Passed (sequence, expiry, stationary pose and dropout tests)
features.known_limitations: Basic RGB heuristic; replay, movable images and sophisticated spoofing can pass

features.feature: Local encrypted settings, biometrics and recovery authorization
features.real_windows_testing: Passed (DPAPI only); interactive authorization not performed
features.known_limitations: Same-account code can decrypt DPAPI data or terminate the process; passphrase recovery requires account-level procedures

features.feature: Authorized owner absence and unknown replacement detection
features.automated_tests: Passed (state machine and connected mocked worker pipeline)
features.known_limitations: Depends on camera quality, recognition threshold and successful liveness

features.feature: Multiple-face relaxed and strict privacy policies
features.known_limitations: Gestures always suspend with multiple visible faces; liveness renewal requires one face

features.feature: Actual Windows LockWorkStation adapter and simulation mode
features.automated_tests: Passed (mocked API only; no real lock)
features.known_limitations: No unlocking or credential-provider integration; simulation latches until authorized reset

features.feature: Camera reconnect, blocked/frozen feed handling and failure policy
features.known_limitations: Exact-static feeds may cause false freeze alerts; native drivers may block

features.feature: Left and right L, fist and normalized pinch recognition
features.automated_tests: Passed (synthetic geometry; actual Hand Landmarker blank inference)
features.known_limitations: Rule-based confidence is not a calibrated probability; occlusion and hand pose affect recognition

features.feature: Handedness calibration and mirrored-preview handling
features.known_limitations: Camera mirroring and individual hand poses require real calibration

features.feature: Gesture debounce, cooldown, confidence and neutral rearming
features.known_limitations: No-hand frames do not rearm; neutral hand must be visible

features.feature: Fresh verified-owner gate and foreground application cancellation
features.known_limitations: Hands cannot be biometrically attributed to an owner; native COM calls cannot be made atomic with foreground changes

features.feature: PowerPoint navigation, boundaries and slideshow-only exit
features.known_limitations: Custom-show navigation refused; Presenter View and multi-instance matching may conservatively refuse commands

features.feature: Word page scrolling, pause/toggle and cursor preservation
features.known_limitations: Exact pages in Print/Web layouts; one screen in Read Mode; Draft/Outline show guidance

features.feature: Editable per-application gesture mappings
features.known_limitations: Global gesture disable must be restored in UI/tray, not by a gesture

features.feature: Eight-page dark GUI, preview, overlays and status indicators
features.real_windows_testing: Offscreen Windows render passed; interactive camera UI not performed
features.known_limitations: Real display scaling and interactive workflow require manual review

features.feature: Tray and minimized background monitoring
features.automated_tests: Passed (GUI construction and mocked worker loop)
features.known_limitations: Regular desktop process; cannot monitor if process is terminated or entire GUI process hangs

features.feature: Optional Windows per-user startup
features.real_windows_testing: Not performed; registry was not changed
features.known_limitations: Runs only after user sign-in; install paths must remain valid

features.feature: Locked-session suppression and sleep/stall invalidation
features.known_limitations: Secure desktop query is conservative; resume may require prompt verification or trigger absence lock

features.feature: Capture/inference watchdog, worker cleanup and COM error handling
features.known_limitations: Native driver/COM hangs and whole-process crashes need manual recovery; in-process watchdog cannot rescue a dead process

features.feature: Rotating diagnostics, no raw-frame retention and biometric deletion
features.known_limitations: Backups and SSD history may retain older encrypted copies; Python memory cannot guarantee zeroization

features.feature: Offline pinned model setup and portable PyInstaller executable
features.automated_tests: Passed (checksums, source/frozen safe self-tests and GUI smoke checks)
features.real_windows_testing: Passed (safe executable diagnostics on development Windows); other-PC test not performed
features.known_limitations: Unsigned one-folder distribution; not an installer; LGPL and model notices must accompany redistribution

features.feature: CPU scheduling and presentation performance
features.automated_tests: Passed (bounded mocked worker flow); FPS/long-run performance not measured
features.known_limitations: Capture/preview/inference rates are targets dependent on hardware and workload

features.feature: Configurable authentication hysteresis and benign-dropout grace
features.automated_tests: Passed: acquisition/retention, grace, true absence, clear unknown rejection and continuous liveness
features.real_windows_testing: Enrollment aggregate integrity inspected; physical movement accuracy pending
features.known_limitations: Grace temporarily retains recent authentication, including brief zero-face observations; thresholds are not population calibrated

features.feature: Central versioned application state and stale-result rejection
features.automated_tests: Passed: concurrent publication, capture watermarks, command epochs, replaced-worker GUI revision checks
features.known_limitations: In-process state cannot survive whole-process death

features.feature: Process-aware Office inventory and traceable gesture events
features.automated_tests: Passed: background/editor/slideshow, process identity, COM errors, multimonitor target, event dispatch and STA lifecycle mocks
features.real_windows_testing: Read-only installed/process inventory passed; actual gesture commands pending
features.known_limitations: Multiple instances/custom shows/native COM stalls still require laptop tests

features.feature: Independent bounded face inference and Developer Diagnostics
features.automated_tests: Passed: latest-only mailbox, model exception recovery, stale inputs and GUI construction
features.real_windows_testing: Long-run FPS/CPU and optional diagnostics UX pending
features.known_limitations: Native model calls cannot safely be killed from Python
